FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 8, 2026 Achilles Campaign receives nearly $250k in the last 60 days! BOISE, Idaho — Todd Achilles, independent candidate for U.S. Senate, announced today that his campaign brought in nearly $250,000 ($243,281) over the previous 60 days, with 1,017 contributions. 86 percent of contributors live in Idaho. Since launching the campaign on July 1st, 2025, the Achilles campaign has raised over $750,000. “This campaign is funded by Idahoans,” said Achilles. “More than a thousand people chipped in because they want a senator who answers to this state, not to party bosses or corporate PACs in Washington.” More than $35,000 of the total came in the final 72 hours of the period, a late surge the campaign says it intends to carry into the third quarter as it expands organizing and outreach across the state. The campaign has seen growing support across the state for its focus on housing costs, public lands, health care, and the cost of living for working families. “When 86 percent of your contributors live in Idaho, there’s no question who you work for,” Achilles said. The campaign will file its full second-quarter report with the Federal Election Commission by the July 15 deadline. ABOUT TODD ACHILLES Todd Achilles, 58, is an Army veteran, former state legislator, public policy professor, and business executive. He grew up on a family farm, served as a U.S. Army tank commander and armor officer, spent over 20 years in senior leadership roles at T-Mobile, Hewlett-Packard, and several technology startups, and served in the Idaho House of Representatives before resigning in July 2025 to launch his U.S. Senate campaign. He lives in Boise with his family.
